title: Authentication-key continuity
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Compare overlapping validation-key labels with incompatible v1/v2 rotation for existing cookie and token fixtures; never relabel authentication failures as successful migration.
preconditions: A modern browser with JavaScript; open index.html directly, with no server or account.
Public, non-secret fixture-old and fixture-next labels stand in for keys; validation is a deterministic lookup, not real authentication.
Each synthetic profile contributes two valid-credential journeys: old from v1 to v2 and next from v2 to v1.
actions: Select cookie or token, overlap or incompatible rotation, 1 to 8 profiles, and complete or one missing observation.
Rehearse; inspect accepted, rejected and unknown counts, both version policies, tamper probes, verifier and migration verdict separately.
Compare another run or reset controls while retaining all recorded history.
assertions: Compatible overlap accepts all observed valid cross-version credentials.
Incompatible policies reject valid cross-version credentials and migration remains failure even when the expected-negative verifier passes.
Missing replies stay unknown and in the attempted-journey denominator; observed failure takes precedence.
Tampered fixtures are rejected on both versions in both modes.
Invalid input or a ninth run cannot mutate history; reset preserves all prior failures and unknowns.
limits: No real cookies, bearer tokens, signatures, key material, credentials or identity registrations.
No Azure management calls, IaC, cloud resources, deployments or expenditure.
No real authentication, native platform, source-parent completion, production Node.js 24 or availability certification.
History is in-memory for this page session only; reload starts a new session.
No wall-clock timing, token expiry, key propagation, issuer/audience negotiation or production rotation policy is modeled.
Node.js 22.23.4, offline Playwright 1.56.1 and installed signed Edge are test tooling only.
acceptance: Parent-owned empirical review required; no self-awarded Done credit.
